references.text: The first time the Pharisees ask about the man's identity and the miracle, before they in verse 19 pose the question directly to his parents.
The parents confirm that he is their son and that he was born blind, but do not explain how he sees, which directly answers the question in verse 19.
The healed man emphasizes that it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind, confirming the wonder expressed in verse 19.
The prophecy that the blind shall see provides the messianic context for the amazement at how a person born blind can now see.
